source_policy: previously studied development mechanism diagnostic; no source search
OSA03: excluded from execution; retained as historical planning context only; bounded four-source primary comparison

classification_rules.endpoint_tolerance: one integration tick + 1e-9; recovery with no baseline endpoint requires observed canonical endpoint
classification_rules.compensation: recovery or >=1 tick attachment improvement or meaningful AUC when both attach at zero; cannot waive positive endpoint gate
classification_rules.tradeoff: at least two sources with meaningful transition gain AND endpoint/attachment/safety loss or TV increase >=10% AND >=.1; command units m/s and rad/s respectively
classification_rules.precedence_reason: repeated tradeoffs/regressions precede broad staging condition so they cannot be masked

wrapper: prepend exact fixed B to unchanged saved world/local rows; all local rows in observation frame A
evaluation: full original FRESH; frozen forward-only projection and sampled .30s dwell; own reference secondary
control_window: held interval start t in [0,.3); TV between sampled held commands including u_B_plus, excluding pre-B jump; incomplete window null
boundary_only_effect: N/A: no compatible saved no-B raw Native rollout in these four sources
